messages:
Nina K: FYI hit a strange PATH/install problem on Windows during the redwoodctl quickstart. installer completed but `redwoodctl` not found in PowerShell.
Omar: did it add to user PATH or system PATH?
Nina K: installer output said 'added to PATH', but new PowerShell session still couldn't find command. Restart didn't help.
Omar: sometimes the installer writes a shim to %USERPROFILE%\bin and expects that to be in PATH. can you paste `echo $env:PATH`?
Nina K: PATH has C:\Users\nina\bin but the shim was in C:\Users\nina\AppData\Local\redwood\bin.
BuildBot: deploy-notice: telemetry opt-in prompt added to installer (v0.12.3).
Omar: ah, this was a change where we moved per-user bin but forgot to update the installer PATH logic for PowerShell non-login shells. The fix is to add a registry update for PATH or write a shim into a directory already on PATH.
Nina K: workarounds: added C:\Users\nina\AppData\Local\redwood\bin to PATH manually and now `redwoodctl login` works. but surprised the installer didn't warn about needing a shell restart or session type.
Omar: actionable: add a post-install notice "If redwoodctl not found, add %LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood\bin to PATH or reopen shells" and detect non-login PowerShell to suggest restart.
DevEx Bot: filed DEVEX-1589: "installer(win): ensure redwoodctl shim location is discoverable in common PowerShell sessions; clarify post-install messaging"
Nina K: also logging that `redwoodctl login` on Windows failed initially because the device auth web view couldn't open due to default browser handling of msedge-beta. after PATH fix login flow succeeded with manual copy of device code.
Omar: add a short troubleshooting note in Windows quickstart: browser fails -> copy/paste device code, and point to env var REDWOODCTL_BROWSER=none to force CLI copy mode.
Nina K: thanks, saving the steps in onboarding doc.
